Difficulty maintaining brand consistency across designs

goals: Create stunning professional LinkedIn banners in seconds
Maintain consistent brand identity across all designs

target_audience.usage_context: Professionals use this tool when updating their LinkedIn profiles, launching personal branding campaigns, preparing for job searches, or creating content for social media marketing. Usage peaks during career transitions, job hunting seasons, and when users need fresh content for their professional presence.

product_vision.one_liner: AI-powered LinkedIn banner designer that creates stunning professional banners in seconds using multi-LLM orchestration and voice-powered workflows
product_vision.problem_statement: Creating professional LinkedIn banners requires expensive design tools, advanced design skills, or hiring designers - leaving most professionals with generic or low-quality banners that fail to represent their personal brand effectively
product_vision.value_proposition: Nanobanna Pro combines multiple cutting-edge AI models (Gemini for image generation, OpenRouter for diverse LLM access, Replicate for image processing) with voice-powered creation to deliver professional-quality banners without design expertise - faster and more affordable than alternatives
success_metrics: Number of banners generated per user per month
Time from signup to first banner export
Feature adoption rate (voice, A/B testing, tool chains)

competitive_context.market_position: Nanobanna Pro positions itself as a specialized AI-powered tool for career professionals, sitting between complex professional tools (Figma, Photoshop) and generic template platforms (Canva, Crello). The focus on LinkedIn/career branding with voice AI and multi-model orchestration creates a unique niche for career-conscious professionals who want professional results without design expertise.
